places.name: Chennai
places.description: Capital of Tamil Nadu. Must-see: Marina Beach, Kapaleeshwarar Temple, Fort St George, Government Museum. Best time: October to February. Try filter coffee, idli, dosa.

places.name: Mahabalipuram
places.description: UNESCO World Heritage site. Shore Temple, Five Rathas, Arjuna's Penance. Best time: October to March. Near Chennai.

places.name: Madurai
places.description: Temple city. Meenakshi Amman Temple, Thirumalai Nayak Palace. Best time: October to March. Try Jigarthanda and Kari Dosa.

places.name: Rameswaram
places.description: Holy island. Ramanathaswamy Temple, Dhanushkodi. Part of Char Dham. Best time: October to April.

places.name: Kanyakumari
places.description: Southernmost tip of India. Vivekananda Rock, Thiruvalluvar Statue, sunrise and sunset. Best time: October to March.

places.name: Ooty
places.description: Queen of Hill Stations. Ooty Lake, Botanical Garden, Doddabetta, Nilgiri Toy Train. Best time: March to June, September to November.
places.best_season: March to June, September to November

places.name: Kodaikanal
places.description: Princess of Hill Stations. Kodaikanal Lake, Coaker's Walk, Pillar Rocks, Bryant Park. Best time: September to May.

places.name: Thanjavur
places.description: Brihadeeswarar Temple (Big Temple) UNESCO site, Thanjavur Palace, art and music. Best time: October to March.

places.name: Yercaud
places.description: Hill station near Salem. Lady's Seat, Yercaud Lake, coffee plantations. Best time: September to May.

places.name: Hogenakkal Falls
places.description: Cauvery falls; coracle rides. Best time: July to October. Near Dharmapuri.

places.name: Courtallam
places.description: Spa of South India; medicinal waterfalls. Best time: June to September. Tenkasi district.

places.name: Yelagiri
places.description: Small hill station. Swamimalai trek, Punganur Lake. Best time: October to March.

places.name: Velankanni
places.description: Our Lady of Good Health basilica. Major Christian pilgrimage. Best time: September to March.

places.name: Chidambaram
places.description: Nataraja Temple; cosmic dance. Kanaka Sabai. Best time: October to March.

places.name: Kanchipuram
places.description: City of thousand temples. Ekambareswarar, Kailasanathar, Varadharaja. Kanjeevaram silk. Best time: October to March.

places.name: Pondicherry
places.description: French Quarter, Promenade Beach, Auroville, Matrimandir. Best time: October to March.

travel_tips: Carry hat, sunglasses, and sunscreen in summer.
Stay hydrated; drink bottled or filtered water.
Dress modestly in temples (shoulders and knees covered).
Remove footwear before entering temple sanctums.
Bargain in local markets but be respectful.
Keep valuables safe; be aware of surroundings.
Book hill station and train tickets in advance.
Carry light woolens for Ooty, Kodaikanal, Yercaud.
safety_advice: Do not accept food or drinks from strangers.
Keep copies of ID and emergency numbers.

festivals.name: Pongal
festivals.note: Harvest festival; Jallikattu in some districts.

transport.trains: Chennai Central, Egmore; Madurai Junction; Coimbatore; Trichy; major towns connected.
transport.bus: TNSTC and private buses connect all districts.
transport.local: Chennai Metro; autos and taxis in cities; rent cars for long trips.

keywords.answer: Top places: Chennai (Marina, temples), Mahabalipuram (Shore Temple), Madurai (Meenakshi), Rameswaram, Kanyakumari, Ooty, Kodaikanal, Thanjavur (Big Temple), Yercaud, Hogenakkal, Courtallam. Explore by category: Temple, Beach, Hill Station, Heritage, Nature, Wildlife.
Temples near Chennai: Kapaleeshwarar (Mylapore), Mahabalipuram Shore Temple, Kanchipuram (Ekambareswarar, Kailasanathar), Chidambaram Nataraja, Tiruvannamalai Arunachaleswarar, Vellore Golden Temple.
In Madurai try: Jigarthanda (cold drink), Kari Dosa, Parotta, Pongal, street snacks near Meenakshi Temple.
Ooty: March to June and September to November. Kodaikanal: September to May. Yercaud: September to May. Carry light woolens.
Rameswaram: Nearest airport Madurai. Train via Pamban Bridge (scenic). Buses from Madurai, Trichy, Chennai. Island connected by road and rail.
Emergency numbers: Police - 100, Ambulance - 108, Fire - 101. Keep these saved. For disaster management: 1077.
Travel safety: Dress modestly in temples, drink bottled water, keep valuables safe, avoid isolated areas at night, carry ID copies, save emergency numbers (100, 108, 101).
Major festivals: Pongal (Jan), Chithirai in Madurai (Apr-May), Navaratri (Sep-Oct), Mahabalipuram Dance Festival (Dec-Jan). Plan visits around these for cultural experience.
Common Tamil: Hello - வணக்கம் (Vanakkam), Thank you - நன்றி (Nandri). Use our Translator for more phrases in Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada.

Tamil Nadu suits all budgets. Low: buses, modest hotels, local food. Medium: trains, mid-range hotels. Luxury: flights, heritage stays (Chettinad, Ooty), guided tours. Use our Budget Calculator for estimates.
Use our Hotel Finder to filter by city, budget, and rating. Major cities and hill stations have good options; book in advance for Ooty, Kodaikanal, and festival times.
Use the Voice Travel Guide to ask aloud: 'Best places in Tamil Nadu', 'Show temples near Madurai'. It uses the same knowledge base for instant answers.
